prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 2D hand-drawn animation cels. Draw a square 4-column by 4-row sheet of EXACTLY SIXTEEN isolated mushroom CANOPY PARTS on true transparent background. One cap per cell, all fully within their cells, generous margins. NO bodies, NO stems, NO eggs, NO side mushrooms, NO face, NO ground, NO glow, NO text or grid. Only the salmon dome and dark maroon gills. Thin dark green outline, painterly highlights upper left, same slightly top-down frontal game camera as the references.

Image1 is the exact SMALL open canopy design. Image2 is the exact ADULT open canopy design. Image3 gives the fully bowed closed canopy design. These are NOT ears or mouths: retain a coherent rounded mushroom canopy, no melted folds, no vertical drooping tubes, no angular holes. Complete clean contours; a smooth curved upward recess in the lower central edge is allowed in OPEN poses, for a separate stem to connect behind, but no rectangular cutouts.

Read row-major left to right:
Cells 1,2,3,4,5,6 = six consecutive SMALL cap drawings lowering from nearly open to fully bowed. Same small size in all six. Gradually tilt/curl the front rim downward; progressively hide the gills and close the central stem recess. Cell6 is fully lowered with continuous low front rim like a closed umbrella.
Cell7 = ADULT fully lowered canopy, same bowed posture as cell6 but adult proportions.
Cells8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15 = eight consecutive ADULT cap drawings lifting from fully lowered to fully open. Gradually uncurl the brim, reveal more maroon underside, and open the smooth central lower-edge recess as in image2. The cap keeps the SAME final width and volume in every adult drawing. Cell15 matches the adult open reference.
Cell16 = same adult open reference, settled.

All six SMALL caps use the identical width and identical scale. All ten ADULT caps use the identical width and identical scale, adult cap about 27% wider than small. No individual zoom to fit cells. Position each cap around the same horizontal center of its cell. The animation will supply vertical placement, so concentrate on accurate successive canopy POSTURE and a coherent smooth dome without size pumping. Body, eggs and stem must never be included. These sixteen drawings will be displayed directly as actual animation source frames.
